description: 嵌入式 IoT 开发技能库：Bug 根因分析、Crash Dump 分析、代码总结，以及"需求→方案→实施计划"完整需求实现链路，配合跨项目知识库（LLM-Wiki 渐进加载）

interface.shortDescription: Embedded IoT development skills and knowledge base
interface.longDescription: Specialized skills for embedded software development: bug root-cause analysis from logs, crash dump analysis (ARM Cortex-R/Cortex-M and RISC-V), code summarization, persistent knowledge base with progressive LLM-Wiki loading (no vector DB), coding standards, and requirement management. Organized by chip platform (EC626, ASR1603, QCX216, UIS8850, UIS8852).
